name: initial-release-feishu-jira-taskrun-loop
title: Initial release Feishu Jira TaskRun loop
description: Wire the first release service-level loop: accepted Feishu jira_analysis command reads Jira issue context, creates SmallKhoj message/task/TaskRun state, and writes TaskRun results back to Jira through integration mappings.
creator: 张岩.ean
notes: Depends on e3a1a65 integration gateway, 8591b10 Jira REST, and f50285c Feishu adapter. This child wires the first service-level vertical loop; real Feishu SDK worker and UI are out of scope.
